integrity: The accompanying proof derives all quantifiers without assuming finite tests prove an infinite theorem. Reproducible tests independently examine 595 finite graphs and 578628 bounded states; no independent audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Counts primitive period-three orbits only, not basins, transient lengths or other periods. Connected finite simple graphs, nonnegative integer chips, parallel degree-threshold rule. The coefficient formula uses exponentially many 3-phase assignments; 1994 general phase partitions and 2006 ring results supply important prior ingredients. Historical equivalence cannot be excluded, especially because one 1992 primary paper was inaccessible in full.
title: Two contiguous chip-energy bands and an exact three-cycle census on connected graphs
